raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Languages & Runtimes: Java 11/17/21, TypeScript, JavaScript ES6+, C#, Python, Node.js, Go (familiar) Containerization & DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (basic), Azure DevOps CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins Multi-file Architecture: Microservices, Spring Boot 3, .NET Core, REST/GraphQL APIs, CQRS, Saga/Outbox, Event- Driven Testing & Quality: JUnit 5, Mockito (90%+ coverage), Playwright E2E, Jest, Integration Testing, Test Automation Documentation: Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0, Technical Specs, README/Wiki authoring, Architectural Decision Records Build & Tooling: Maven (multi-module), Gradle, npm/Webpack, Git, Docker multi-stage builds Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure (App Service, Functions, DevOps, Key Vault, ADB2C), AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda) Frontend: Angular 17, ReactJS, TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS AI / Agentic: MCP Servers, Claude (Anthropic), LangChain, Crew AI, LLM Orchestration, RAG, Prompt Engineering Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, Query Optimisation, Indexing Strategies IAM & Security: OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, Azure ADB2C, CyberArk PAM, SailPoint IGA, RBAC, Zero Trust
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer Chubb | Hyderabad, India
Apr 2026 – Present
Architected and shipped the ADB2C Policy Intelligence Platform as a fully containerized, multi-file Java Spring Boot 3 (Java 17) system: Maven multi-module project, Docker Compose local stack, Azure DevOps CI/CD (Maven → Docker image → Azure App Service); Angular 17 SPA frontend with 12+ enterprise features — cut policy incident resolution time by 60%.
Built deterministic JUnit 5 + Mockito test suite (90%+ coverage) and Playwright E2E suite for the MCP server platform; authored Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0 specs, deployment READMEs, and architectural runbooks to ensure full reproducibility across environments.
Designed and deployed multi-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Java integrating Azure ADB2C, CyberArk PAM & SailPoint IGA REST APIs; owned Docker-based containerization and Azure DevOps pipeline config, enabling zero-downtime rollouts.
Engineered Java Spring Boot service layer for Microsoft Graph API multi-tenant policy synchronisation: OAuth2 client-credentials flow, async polling via Spring @Scheduled, Hibernate-mapped entities with optimistic locking — reproducible across 3 Azure environments.
Built AI error-analysis engine (Spring Boot + JPA-persisted remediation mappings for 30+ AADSTS/AADB2C codes), exposed via versioned REST endpoints, integrated into Agentic AI triage — reduced IAM incident overhead by 40%.
Led architecture standards for multi-file enterprise IAM microservices; defined Docker conventions, coding standards, and PR workflows; mentored 3+ engineers on Spring patterns, JPA optimisation, and cloud-native best practices.
Software Engineer Chubb | Hyderabad, India
May 2024 – Apr 2026
Engineered production MCP server using Crew AI and LangChain for Agentic AI workflows over Active Directory, Netwrix & Azure ADB2C; containerized the full stack with Docker, configured GitHub Actions CI/CD — delivering reproducible, prompt-driven IAM automation at enterprise scale.
Built Java Spring Boot + .NET Core (ASP.NET Web API, C#) SailPoint wrapper APIs; structured multi-file codebase with clean layering (controllers / services / repositories), full Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0 documentation, and automated CI/CD to Azure App Service.
Built Angular 17/TypeScript dashboard with live REST feeds, RBAC views, real-time audit logs; authored component-level unit tests (Jest) and maintained Git feature-branch workflows with structured PR reviews ensuring code quality.
Developed AI error-classification agent in Node.js/TypeScript using LLM-driven diagnosis; containerized via Docker, reducing triage time by 35% and saving 10+ operational hours/week via automated Azure Functions workflows.
Technology Intern Chubb | Hyderabad, India
Sep 2023 – May 2024
Built full-stack enterprise inventory system (Angular 17/TypeScript frontend + Node.js/Express.js backend + MongoDB) in a multi-file monorepo with JWT-based RBAC, REST API integration, real-time analytics dashboards, Docker Compose setup, and structured Git PR workflows.
Software Development Intern IIT Kharagpur | Kharagpur, WB
Jun 2022 – Aug 2022
Developed FHIR-compliant Node.js REST APIs for patient data pipelines (+25% exchange efficiency); documented endpoints with OpenAPI specs; optimised SQL schemas and indexing strategies (+20% throughput); followed Git- based version-controlled development lifecycle.
